title: The Mystery of the Blue Train

vibeProfile.oneLine: A murder and a vanished ruby aboard the glamorous Blue Train.

summary: Aboard the luxurious Blue Train to the Riviera, a wealthy heiress is found murdered and a priceless ruby has vanished. Hercule Poirot, travelling on the same train, is soon sifting the suspects among the glamorous passengers. A classic closed-world Christie of wealth, jewels and buried motives, it moves briskly from London to the sun-struck south of France and rewards the reader who watches the small details as closely as Poirot does.
whyReadIt: Jewels, a luxury train and a Riviera murder. Glamorous, brisk, cosy Christie for a single sitting.

funFacts.text: Christie wrote it during a painful period after her own famous disappearance, and never liked it much.
